t: The Erbauer Masonry Diamond Wall Chasing Blades are a twin pack designed for efficient track cutting in hard materials. These 125mm diameter blades, with a 22.23mm standard bore, are ideal for professional electricians and plumbers creating channels for cables and pipes in concrete and stone. Featuring a 2mm thickness and 7mm sintered segment height, they deliver a quality cut and long life. Suitable for wet and dry use, these blades offer universal application with wall chasers, operating safely up to 12,250rpm.
